caption: The drawing depicts a bouquet composed primarily of several large, blooming roses in shades of white, pink, and deep red. The flowers are surrounded by an array of green leaves in varying shades, with some leaves showing veining details. There are also a few unopened rosebuds and smaller foliage branches interspersed among the larger flowers. The composition of the bouquet is dense at the center and tapers slightly toward the outer edges with stems and leaves extending downward. The bouquet is centered within a rectangular, beige or light brown painted border that frames the inner floral illustration. The background within the border is a muted, off-white color, and the overall drawing is set against a wider, light-colored outer margin. At the bottom right corner of the outer margin, the name "Bessie Vande" is inscribed.
title: Still Life
